proof_summary: Set \(m=39101\) and \(M=2\cdot100943\cdot3^{39101}-1\). Modular computations in \((\mathbb Z/M\mathbb Z)[\sqrt3]\) give a Lucas–Pocklington certificate showing that \(2+\sqrt3\) has order \(M+1\) after reduction modulo every prime divisor of \(M\), using the prime factors \(2,3,100943\) of \(M+1\); Frobenius forces that order to divide \(p\pm1\), contradicting \(p^2\le M\) if \(M\) were composite, so \(M\) is prime and \(m\) is a positive witness.
